def solve_full(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    tw=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    th=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]
    bg=max(set(x for row in g for x in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    def clear(r,c): return g[r][c]==bg
    h2 = len({r for r,_ in tw})==1
    h3 = len({r for r,_ in th})==1
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if h2 and h3:
        r2=min(r for r,_ in tw); r3=min(r for r,_ in th)
        c2lo,c2hi=min(c for _,c in tw),max(c for _,c in tw)
        c3lo,c3hi=min(c for _,c in th),max(c for _,c in th)
        sgn=1 if c3lo>c2hi else -1
        st=c2lo if sgn<0 else c2hi
        e=st
        while 0<=e<W and clear(r2,e): e+=sgn
        e-=sgn
        sgn3=1 if c2hi>c3lo else -1
        st3=c3lo if sgn3>0 else c3hi
        e3=st3
        while 0<=e3<W and clear(r3,e3): e3+=sgn3
        e3-=sgn3
        cand=[c for c in range(min(e,e3),max(e,e3)+1)
              if all(clear(r,c) for r in range(min(r2,r3),max(r2,r3)+1))]
        pick=min(cand) if sgn<0 else max(cand)
        step=-1 if sgn<0 else 1
        for c in range(e,pick+step+1):
            if clear(r2,c): out[r2][c]=3
        step3=-1 if sgn3<0 else 1
        for c in range(pick,e3+step3+1):
            if clear(r3,c): out[r3][c]=3
        for rr in range(min(r2,r3),max(r2,r3)+1):
            if clear(rr,pick): out[rr][pick]=3
        return out
    else:
        c2=min(c for _,c in tw); c3=min(c for _,c in th)
        sgn=1 if th[0][0]>tw[0][0] else -1
        st=min(r for r,_ in tw) if sgn>0 else max(r for r,_ in tw)
        e=st
        while 0<=e<H and clear(e,c2): e+=sgn
        e-=sgn
        st3=min(r for r,_ in th) if sgn>0 else max(r for r,_ in th)
        e3=st3
        while 0<=e3<H and clear(e3,c3): e3+=sgn
        e3-=sgn
        cand=[r for r in range(min(e,e3),max(e,e3)+1)
              if all(clear(r,c) for c in range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1))]
        pick=min(cand) if sgn<0 else max(cand)
        step=-1 if sgn<0 else 1
        for r in range(e,pick+step+1):
            if clear(r,c2): out[r][c2]=3
        step3=-1 if sgn<0 else 1
        for r in range(pick,e3+step3+1):
            if clear(r,c3): out[r][c3]=3
        for cc2 in range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1):
            if clear(pick,cc2): out[pick][cc2]=3
        return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    o=solve_full(G[k+' input'])
    exp=G[k+' output']
    diffs=[(r,c,o[r][c],exp[r][c]) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if o[r][c]!=exp[r][c]]
    print(k,'diffs',len(diffs),diffs[:20])

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    tw=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    th=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]
    cnt={}
    for x in [v for row in g for v in row]: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    def clear(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and g[r][c]==bg
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # orientation
    rs2={r for r,_ in tw}; cs2={c for _,c in tw}
    rs3={r for r,_ in th}; cs3={c for _,c in th}
    horiz = len(cs2)==1 and len(cs3)==1
    if horiz:
        r2=r for r in tw else None
        r2=min(r for r,_ in tw); r3=min(r for r,_ in th)
        c2lo=min(c for _,c in tw); c2hi=max(c for _,c in tw)
        c3lo=min(c for _,c in th); c3hi=max(c for _,c in th)
        sgn=-1 if c3lo<c2lo else 1   # travel direction of 2s toward 3s side
        start=c2hi+1 if sgn>0 else c2lo-1
        # extend 2-line while clear, record farthest extent e2 (a column)
        e2=start
        while 0<=e2<W and clear(r2,e2): e2+=sgn
        cand=[]
        # walk back from e2: a pick p is feasible if vertical run r2..r3 at p clear AND horizontal run on r3 clear (and p within 2-line extent)
        p=e2-(1 if sgn>0 else 0)
        while p != start:
            ok=all(clear(rr,p) for rr in range(min(r2,r3),max(r2,r3)+1))
            if sgn>0:
                oh=all(clear(r3,cc) for cc in range(p,c3lo))
            else:
                oh=all(clear(r3,cc) for cc in range(c3hi,p))
            if ok and oh: cand.append(p)
            p+=sgn
        if not cand: return None
        pick=max(cand) if sgn>0 else min(cand)   # farthest extent
        # paint 2-line extension from pair to pick
        p=start
        while p!=pick:
            out[r2][p]=3; p+=sgn
        # vertical connector
        p=pick
        rr=min(r2,r3)
        while rr!=max(r2,r3):
            out[p][rr]=3; rr+=1 if rr<r2 else -1
        # 3-line extension toward connector: from 3-edge toward pick
        if sgn>0:
            p=c3lo-1
            while abs(p-pick)>0:
                out[r3][p]=3; p-=1
        else:
            p=c3hi+1
            while abs(p-pick)>0:
                out[r3][p]=3; p+=1
        return out
    else:  # vertical
        a2=min(r for r,_ in tw); b2=max(r for r,_ in tw)
        a3=min(r for r,_ in th); b3=max(r for r,_ in th)
        c2=min(c for _,c in tw); c3=min(c for _,c in th)
        sgn=1 if a3>a2 else -1
        e2=a2+1 if sgn>0 else b2-1
        while 0<=e2<H and clear(e2,c2): e2+=sgn
        cand=[]
        p=e2+(1 if sgn>0 else -1)
        while abs(p-e2)<=abs(start:=None)-1: pass
        p=e2+(1 if sgn>0 else -1)
        while True:
            ok=all(clear(rr,p) for rr in range(min(a2,a3),max(b2,b3)+1))
            if not ok: break
            hh=all(clear(rr,cc) for cc in [min(c2,c3)])  # placeholder; handle below
            if hh: cand.append(p)
            p+=(1 if sgn>0 else -1)
            if p==e2: break
        if not cand: return None
        pick=max(cand) if sgn>0 else min(cand)
        r2c=a2 if sgn>0 else b2
        p=r2c
        while p!=pick:
            out[p][c2]=3; p+=sgn
        pp=pick
        cc=min(c2,c3)
        while cc!=max(c2,c3):
            out[pp][cc]=3; cc+=1 if cc<c2 else -1
        # 3-line extension toward connector
        if sgn>0:
            p=a3-1
            while abs(p-pick)>0:
                out[p][c3]=3; p-=1
        else:
            p=b3+1
            while abs(p-pick)>0:
                out[p][c3]=3; p+=1
        return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    o=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']

        for r,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(o,exp)):
            if a!=b: print(r,'got ',''.join(map(str,a)),'\n   want',''.join(map(str,b)))

from collections import deque
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for r in g for v in r), key=lambda k:sum(r.count(k) for r in g))
    starts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
    ends={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    owner={}
    q=deque()
    for s in starts:
        owner[s]=s; q.append(s)
    endcell=None
    while q:
        p=q.popleft()
        if p in ends: endcell=p; break
        i,j=p
        for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and (a,b) not in owner and g[a][b] in (bg,3):
                owner[(a,b)]=p; q.append((a,b))
    p=endcell
    while p not in starts:
        out[p[0]][p[1]]=3; p=owner.get(p)
    return out
